scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npx prisma@^6.19.0 generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.start: npx prisma@^6.19.0 migrate deploy --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm start --prefix server
